title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 28, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 393 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Satellite conditions are a little spicy right now! 🛰⚡📡💡🌞

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
